Agent Name: WomenInComputerScienceHistory_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: This step misinterpreted the Girls Who Code timeline by treating the 24% figure as 2022 (“today”) rather than 2017, despite upstream evidence showing 1995: 37%, 2017: 24%, 2022: 22%. By using 2022, it computed 27 years instead of the correct 22, creating the core factual error (Rule 2). Although later steps could have corrected it, this misreading was the primary reasoning mistake that led to the wrong final result (Rule 3).
